data.narrative:
Defense Unicorns, founded by Rob Slaughter, Jeff McCoy, and Andrew Greene, is a Series B defense-tech company seeking valuation guidance following $171M in total fundraising. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies: 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms in the Defense & Security sector at similar stage.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applied a 1.9x multiplier to the company's last post-money valuation of $1.0B, yielding $1.9B. Peer-median benchmarking across six same-sector, same-stage comparables—Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), Heven AeroTech ($1.0B), and one additional peer—produced a median of $1.1B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B.

Triangulation of both methods supports a valuation range of $956M (low) to $2.2B (high), with a median of $1.5B. The $956M floor reflects downside peer performance; the $2.2B ceiling reflects stage-progression upside. Key uncertainties include revenue and growth trajectory relative to the peer set, capital efficiency post-Series B, and customer concentration in the defense market. The wide peer range ($300M–$3.0B) reflects material heterogeneity in company maturity and market position within the defense-tech segment.
